name: L1_SEALED_EXPLORATION_NATIVE_NORMALIZED_V2
justification: Original gate divides already normalized residual by a small pre-pressure-correction first sample, making acceptance depend on initial velocity seed. Use the verified native normalization reference, not a second reference to that unrepresentative seed. Only activate after native flag and initial transient peak are confirmed. This is an explicit protocol revision, not retroactive PASS of old runs.
scope: Exploration sealed baseline, not mesh validation or training acceptance
